description: Test-everything union (formerly `base`) — the permanent superset the FULL test lane and the cold-boot gate boot against, so a single pytest run exercises EVERY plugin's tests for full coverage. (Tests now live inside each package and collect install-aware — an uninstalled plugin's tests are skipped, not hard-errored, so absence degrades coverage rather than breaking the run; req-dev-validation-collection-complete-4. This union is the FULL-coverage set the all-plugins CI lane owns, req-dev-validation-all-plugins-lane.) NOT a deployment default — a plain spawn boots `core_dev` (core + grid_fixtures); `core` is the product baseline; every other profile is `core` + an explicit plugin set. Installs the package-mode plugin set, seeds the seedable plugins' GRIFT (INSTALLED_APPS order), fires no collectors. Deliberate exception: lotr is installed but NOT seeded — it is the test-fixture/demo vocabulary (core suites build fixtures from grid_fixtures, not lotr), so its Middle-earth GRIFT belongs in a demo profile. The `install` section MUST cover every plugin the population seeds (pre-boot's coherence guard aborts otherwise) PLUS install-only plugins: samsite's import-time deps (roscale, sigstore_core), the test-fixture vocabularies (lotr, grid_fixtures), and the gryphon_playground corpus — none of which carry a grift seed. Add a profile with fire-collector steps (e.g. samsite) to pull the live world in. See req-boot-minimal-baseline (spec-tap-boot-v0.md) + req-dev-validation-suite-tiers.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.administrivia). TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia; seeded in population.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.computing_core). Vendor-neutral computing-primitive dimension; seeded in population.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.roscale). Install-only: registers the OSCAL workbench panel types samsite's compliance pages consume; no grift seed, so it is not a population step, but samsite imports it at ready() — it must be installed.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). Install-only substrate: cross-cutting federated-identity vocabulary (the oidc_issuer convergence node) + issuer identity primitives. github_core imports its issuer helper; aws_core/sigstore_core/samsite reference identity_core__oidc_issuer as an edge endpoint — listed before them so its type registers first. Owns no collector and no edges; no GRIFT population seed.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.aws_core). Tier-0 boto3 dep (uv resolves at install). AWS dimension + region reference data; seeded in population (its collector is NOT fired in base).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.sigstore_core). Tier-0 sigstore dep. Install-only library plugin: samsite's compliance_collector imports its verify/decompose helpers + models at ready(); no grift seed of its own — must be installed.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core). Tier-0 PyYAML dep (uv resolves at install). GitHub repo landing page; seeded in population.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.compliance_core). Install-only substrate: regime-agnostic compliance vocabulary (compliance_artifact + compliance_context in Phase A). fedramp_20x_ksi + samsite depend_on it — listed before them so its types register first. No GRIFT population seed of its own.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.fedramp_20x_ksi). FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension + catalog/compliance pages; seeded in population (catalog collector NOT fired in base).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.samsite). The demo integration surface; seeded in population. DEPENDS ON roscale/sigstore_core/github_core (import time) + aws_core nodes — listed last so its cross-plugin deps install first. Its collectors are NOT fired in base (base reaches out to nothing).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the core suites + the Gryphon playground build fixtures from (the load-bearing test-fixture role lotr also fills). No GRIFT population seed, so not a population step — just installed + reconciled. No cross-plugin deps. Listed before gryphon_playground, which depends_on it.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.gryphon_playground). Install-only: the Gridkin scenario corpus + harness that exercise the Gryphon query language. Owns NO node/edge types of its own — its corpus references the grid_fixtures__* vocabulary by string, so it depends_on grid_fixtures (installed before it). Carries NO GRIFT population seed, so it is not a population step — just installed + reconciled.
In-tree validate_plugin test fixture (tap_plugin.validation_sample). Install-only permanent target for the tap_plugins validate_plugin suite; no GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps.
